titleEn: Vancouver Stair Renovation Guide 2026: Costs, Permits and BC Building Code
titleZh: 温哥华楼梯装修指南2026：费用、许可证与建筑法规
contentEn:
Vancouver stair renovation costs range from $3,000 for a basic refinish to $20,000-$45,000 for a full structural replacement. BC Building Code requires minimum 2.1m headroom clearance on landings and transitions, minimum 860mm stair width, and guardrail heights of 920mm for exterior stairs and 1070mm for raised floors more than 660mm above grade. Reno Stars provides free written quotes for all stair projects in Metro Vancouver.

Most stair renovation projects in BC require a building permit because they involve structural or safety components. Permit fees in Metro Vancouver typically run $250-$600. Basic refinish takes 3-7 days. Mid-scope replacement takes 1-2 weeks. Full structural replacement including permits takes 2-5 weeks. Reno Stars has completed stair-related renovations across Metro Vancouver including split-level homes in Burnaby and Coquitlam, and whole-home renovations in Richmond. Every stair project is reviewed by a licensed residential builder.

Get at least three written quotes each itemising scope of work, materials, timeline, permit coordination and payment schedule. Planning a stair renovation or any other renovation project? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.
